PATHFINDER reserves the right to revise prices at any time and especially in order to comply with present or future tax and duty variations to which PATHFINDER is bound when importing, exporting or selling a system.

blocks.title: Warranty
blocks.body:
4.1 The warranty by PATHFINDER is expressly limited to correction of defects in workmanship and material compared with the technical specifications communicated by PATHFINDER to the CUSTOMER for a period of three (3) months, following installation and shall at all times be subject to PATHFINDER'S acknowledgement of its responsibility upon CUSTOMER'S claims in writing. PATHFINDER may choose to repair or replace any equipment presenting manufacturing or raw material defect. In no case will PATHFINDER be held liable for any defects or damages resulting from a non-compliance with PATHFINDER technical manual and operator's handbook. The CUSTOMER acknowledges its obligation to employ and assign qualified and trained staff for the operation of the equipment.

4.2 The present warranty does not include any other warranty of any kind, whether express or implied, and in particular any implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose. CUSTOMER hereby acknowledges the appropriate use and fitness for purpose of the hardware in connection with its specific needs or application.

4.3 The present warranties are not applicable in case of failure resulting from an accident, a defective use or in case of maintenance or modifications not performed or authorised by PATHFINDER in writing.

4.4 The present warranties shall be rendered void in the event of modification or extension of the configuration not expressly authorised in writing by PATHFINDER.

4.5 Subject to contrary local public policy, and if the sale is an end user sale, this hardware is not intended for resale and the warranty supplied shall not be transferred. In case of sale through retailer or distributor, PATHFINDER'S responsibility is limited to the present warranty and any additional warranty will be the sole responsibility of the retailer.

blocks.title: Pathfinder Remote Support Program (RSP)
blocks.body:
## Pathfinder Remote Support Program (RSP)

**Low Cost • Free Software Upgrades • Free Technical Support • Discounted Parts**

RSP was created to provide support at an affordable cost with features that give immediate benefits. Pathfinder also wanted to reward our customers who remain on the program. The immediate benefits include access to our factory support team by phone and email including machine diagnostic remedy via direct internet connection.

RSP customers have priority over "On Call" customers while "Full Support Contract" customers have priority over "RSP" customers.

### RSP Details

**Consumable & Spare part sales:**
10% discount for all consumables and spare parts.

**Software updates:**
Free PathCut™ & PathWorks™ software updates covered when the customer commits to two (2) consecutive years in the program. Available in 2nd consecutive year on the program.

**Support:**
Phone support, composing and responding to emails, internal problem solving and remote login where available are included in the program. Remote internet access to customer's machines required for remote diagnostics. Remote access enables software upgrades and eliminates onsite service costs where remote access can resolve the issue.

**Parts Return:**
Refer to Pathfinder's Parts Return Policy.

**Requesting Support:**
Support requests should be made directly with the Pathfinder office. Urgent requests should be followed up with a phone call.

- Email: support@pathfindercut.com
- Phone: Contact Pathfinder AEST 8:30am - 5:00pm Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

**Payment:**
12 months in advance.

**Renewal:**
Renewal shall be automatic unless notification is given as per 8 a).

**Cancellation:**
Customer may cancel at any time 30 days prior to date of expiry. Email to: support@pathfindercut.com or registered post. Cancellations prior to fulfilment of 2 consecutive years RSP will incur cost of any software upgrades received within this period (refer to section 3).

Pathfinder reserves the right to cancel RSP at any time and refund customer remaining 'unused' portion calculated pro-rata from date of notification.

**Multiple products:**
Where a customer has multiple of the same Pathfinder product, RSP (Remote Support Program) is not available for a single product.

Example: Customer with 2 x M-series cutting machines — RSP is not available for only one M-series cutter. Both M-series cutters will need to be covered under the program.

**Pricing:**
Labour and travel hourly rates are subject to change in accordance with Pathfinder's pricing policy. RSP pricing may be subject to change in accordance with CPI increases.

Additional machines which are purchased will automatically join the RSP at additional cost.
